'''Fekunza''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Dahe]], the world's most populous country and largest economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]]. The city had a population of 15,400,000 at the [[Dahe|Dahen]] 1764 census, ranking it the [[List of cities and dependencies by population|thirteenth-largest city in the world]] by population. It is the seat of the [[Central Bank of Fekunza]], the issuing authority of the [[Lahn]], one of the two globally backed reserve currencies of [[Andah]]. The city is administered by the office of the Kega of Fekunza under the [[Dahen]] municipal system.
